title: Impact input validation
responsibility: Validates impact graph shapes and graph integrity in the fixed order shared by runtime implementations.

inputs.name: kernelRequest.input
inputs.description: Unknown impact input containing base/head node-and-edge graphs and changed, uncertain and sink id arrays.

inputs.name: isObject.value
inputs.description: Value to check for a non-null, non-array object.

outputs.name: kernelRequest
outputs.description: Validated impact input, or an invalid-request/invalid-graph failure. Graph fields are checked before id lists, then duplicate nodes and out-of-range edges are checked base before head.

outputs.name: isObject
outputs.description: True for any non-null object except arrays; no plain-object or prototype restriction is applied.
